explanation: In the 1990s an oviraptorid embryo turned up inside an identical egg, and relatives were found fossilized sitting on their nests, arms spread over the eggs like brooding birds.

claims.text: The eggs found with the first Oviraptor fossil were laid by oviraptorid dinosaurs, its own kind, not by Protoceratops.
The eggs did not belong to Protoceratops, Velociraptor or a crocodile.
In the 1990s, an oviraptorid embryo was found inside an egg of the same type as those found with the first Oviraptor fossil.
Fossils of oviraptorid relatives such as Citipati have been found sitting on nests with their arms spread over the eggs.
